name: 1Zpresso ZP6
details: Hand grinder for filter coffee. External dial read in numbers (“points”): 10 clicks per number, 9 numbers per rotation; 4.5 = #4 and 5 clicks.

grindRanges.scale: dial numbers from zero (burrs closed); 4.5 = #4 and 5 clicks

notes.espresso: 1Zpresso's ZP6 Special chart lists no espresso range.

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “ZP6 Special Grind Setting Reference” chart (ZP6-special-Grind-Setting-Reference-20221031.jpg on that page): siphon/pour over 4–5, French press 5–6 (points).
